items.title: Connect classes
items.text: New [[class]] blocks in beeircd.conf give groups of people their own limits, picked by security group (so by country, network, TLS, web chat or IP range). A class can set its own connections per IP, the most people in it at once, sendq, ping times, flood burst and rate and channel limit, or deny people with the normal ban text; anything it leaves out comes from [limits], and with no classes nothing changes.

items.title: Hive Panel
items.text: A Connect classes card on Settings shows every class, how many people are in it and its limits.

items.title: Link rules
items.text: A [[link.server]] block can carry rule = "...", UnrealIRCd's crule words (connected, directcon, via, directop with &&, || and !), so a server links only while the network is in the right shape, for example a leaf that joins hub2 only while hub1 is gone; with rule_for = "all" the rule also covers incoming links and oper CONNECT.

items.title: Hive Panel
items.text: The Linked servers page shows which blocks have a link rule, lets you change it in the form, refuses a rule that doesn't parse, and says when a rule stopped a link.

items.title: Hive Panel
items.text: What happened icons sit on a soft tinted tile.
